# Project instructions

This is a Rust project.

## Generated files

The `target/` directory contains generated Rust build artifacts.

Never inspect, modify, or use files under `target/` as source context.
Prefer the actual source code and project configuration.

## Development workflow

- Use `cargo fmt` for formatting.
- Use `cargo check` for fast compilation checks.
- Use `cargo test` when tests are relevant.
- Follow existing project conventions before introducing new abstractions.
- Keep changes focused on the requested task.
